            )

        self.group[level_key]._v_attrs.kind = conv_level.dtype.name
        self.group[level_key]._v_attrs.name = name

        # write the name
        setattr(self.group[level_key]._v_attrs, f"{key}_name{name}", name)

        # write the labels
